explanation: The interior critical point (0,0) gives 0. On 2x²+y=1, Lagrange multipliers give -4x=4λx and 2y=λ. For x≠0, λ=-1, so y=-1/2 and x=±√3/2, giving -5/4; x=0 gives y=1 and value 1. To verify the global minimum on this unbounded region, the constraint implies -2x²≥y-1, so f≥y²+y-1=(y+1/2)²-5/4. Equality is attained at the candidates above.
